'''"Asharl-kin" Basterosa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] and a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Hidden Chain]]. She was involved in the [[raid on Kessan's Landing]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], where she was killed. She was a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] who trained a pet [[Asharl panther/Legends|asharl panther]] known as [[Basterosa's "Baby"]].<ref name="TOR:CoC"/>
